SELECT rr.*, u.user_name AS receptionistName FROM yjx_repair_request rr LEFT JOIN yjx_user u ON rr.receptionist_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN yjx_user cu ON cu.user_id = #{userId} WHERE 1=1 AND (cu.role_id IN (1,3) OR rr.user_id = #{userId})
AND ( rr.phone_model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR rr.phone_issue_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY
rr.created_at rr.request_id rr.created_at
DESC ASC
